question: \(OP\) bisects \(\angle AOB\), \(PD\perp OA\) at \(D\), \(PE\perp OB\) at \(E\), \(PD=3x-2\), and \(PE=x+6\). Find the value of \(x\).
solution: A point on an angle bisector is equidistant from the two sides, so \(3x-2=x+6\). Solving gives \(x=4\).
